title: How To Use This Project
description: Inspired from [Hugo](https://gohugo.io/), this project automatically inflates your Markdown files into static website, with no local installation needed. Click on '`How To Use This Project`' to know more.

title: Reliable UDP Based Game
description: Computer Networks' Course Semester Project demonstrating the use of Go-BackN(GBN) $\&$ Selective Repeat Request(SRR) for achieving reliable communication over UDP using raw [c-sockets](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/socket.2.html), into a [Raylib](https://www.raylib.com/) based simple game.
